loading.missingOrInvalid: retain last valid rules and mark unavailable
loading.publisher: official Sentinel Dashboard 1.8.9 native pages publish through Nacos CAS; successful persistence does not confirm client loading
loading.listenerRegistrationException: unready; background retry with bounded exponential delay; latest valid rules retained
loading.unchangedRule: accepted; Sentinel may report no change
loading.apiPredicateSemantics: official matchStrategy 1 accepts non-wildcard expressions; actual matcher behavior follows Sentinel
loading.version: raw UTF-8 Nacos content MD5; stale or rejected compare-and-set does not report success
loading.missingData: publisher refuses missing or invalid data; initialize each Data ID with an explicit array
loading.dashboardClientState: unverified until independently observed at each client
loading.jsonSyntax: One complete JSON value only; duplicate object fields, additional root values, and trailing non-whitespace are rejected by the Dashboard and clients.

apiPredicateSemantics: matchStrategy 0 exact, 1 Ant path pattern (use /** for descendants), 2 regex

ordinaryService.enable: Add knode-governance dependency, enable knode.governance.enabled and provide explicit Nacos address/namespace.
ordinaryService.httpResource: HTTP <UPPERCASE_METHOD> <Spring MVC best-matching path template>; actuator excluded; async work after handoff is not protected.
ordinaryService.feignResource: feign:<client>#<operation>; caller must wrap the synchronous Feign invocation with GovernedCall.execute.
ordinaryService.failure: HTTP flow block 429; HTTP circuit block and protected dependency error/block 503; callers may explicitly handle GovernanceUnavailableException.
ordinaryService.flowConstraints: Sentinel validation, finite count; cluster mode unsupported and maxQueueingTimeMs <= 1000 in this client.
ordinaryService.readiness: Include governanceRules in the application readiness health group.
ordinaryService.heartbeat: Use official Sentinel JVM properties before startup; simple HTTP command port binds all interfaces and is unauthenticated. Firewall or isolate it.
ordinaryService.feignExample: governedCall.execute("feign:catalog#get", () -> catalogClient.get(id)); configure finite Feign connect/read timeouts.
ordinaryService.feignFailureSemantics: Any Exception escaping the wrapped call, including Feign non-2xx exceptions, is traced and translated to 503. Handle expected business responses inside the callable if they must retain their own semantics.
ordinaryService.logging: At most one invalid-update warning per Data ID until recovery; retry warnings are emitted at attempts 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16.

configurationTls: No dedicated Nacos TLS environment switch is defined by these templates; transport and trust configuration must be supplied and verified for the chosen Nacos client and deployment.
